text:
Marta V.: Hi all, day 1 question 1 I can open Redwood Console after SSO but when I click into Feature Flags I get an empty table and the network shows 403 on /api/projects/alpha/flags.
Marta V.: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/projects/alpha/flags returns {"error":"forbidden","message":"project_scope_missing"}. Do contractors need different scoping?
Liam (Infra): Welcome Marta! :wave: Contractors sometimes get org:contractor scoping which doesn't include project access. Share your SSO email and contractor tag and I'll check your role mapping.
Marta V.: marta.v@redwood.ai, contractor:yes. Thanks.
Onboarding Bot: Access audit created: AUD-1225 for marta.v@redwood.ai. Link: https://redwood.internal/audit/AUD-1225
Liam (Infra): Yep, you're in org:contractor. I'll add a project-scope mapping so you get project:alpha console-read. Refresh the session after I flip it.
Marta V.: Session refreshed, still 403 for flags but the UI now shows projects.
Liam (Infra): If you still see 403, run this and paste the x-request-id:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/projects/alpha/flags 2>&1 | grep x-request-id
```
Marta V.: x-request-id: rq_zz9a01.
Jules (DevEx): If you need to demo toggling a flag during your intro, I can grant a temporary ff-operator role scoped to project:alpha for 20 minutes. DM me the flag key.
Marta V.: I'll need to flip feature 'alpha.user_onboarding' for a short demo at 3pm PT. DMing Jules now.
Sana (Security): Quick note: service accounts and operator roles for contractors require an explicit sponsor and expiry. If you request ff-operator, include sponsor (your manager) and expiry in the request. Read-only scopes for contractors can be approved for 90 days by default.
Liam (Infra): I applied the project mapping and cleared an allowlist check for your IP. Try again.
Marta V.: 30 Prod flags table loads and I can see the keys. Demo access with temporary ff-operator worked, thanks everyone!
Sana (Security): Filed a short note in the audit: AUD-1225 updated with sponsor and expiry. Keep the service-account template handy: https://redwood.internal/security/service-account-template.md
Marta V.: Closing loop 1 huge help :thumbsup:
